title: RAND: bit-exact 16-bit LFSR
alt: JavaScript rand() function: a 16-bit linear feedback shift register matching the 6502 RAND routine

title: Radix misinterpretation (EFIRE)
alt: The 6502 line LDA I,10. under .RADIX 16 means decimal 10; version 1 generated 18, version 2 corrects it to 10

title: BCD score threshold (ENEMY)
alt: The 6502 compare CMP I,30 on the BCD high byte means 30,000 points; version 1 used 3000, version 2 uses 30000

title: Bitmask cadence (EFIRE)
alt: 6502 code loading FRAME, shifting left with ASL and branching if not zero, which fires every 128 frames
code:
; EFIRE routine:
LDA FRAME
ASL
BNE 10$

title: Two-player turn switch fix (checkWave)
alt: checkWave() turn transition that sets ship.sdelay to 0x10 so the next player's ship appears after 16 ticks

title: POST /v1/systemone: request and response (abridged)
alt: A typed request with a state sentence and four action criteria, and the response with the chosen action and its confidence
code:
POST /v1/systemone
{ "state": "Situation: Danger. large rock is incoming from the right on a
             collision path in 21 ticks. Pilot needs to turn left and thrust
             to dodge.",
  "questions": { "action": {
    "type": "choice",
    "instructions": "Determine the required flight action for the spaceship.",
    "criteria": {
      "stay_and_fire":
        "Safe situation. Aim weapons towards target rock and fire.",
      "turn_left_and_thrust":
        "Asteroid on right side. Turn left and thrust away to dodge.",
      "turn_right_and_thrust":
        "Asteroid on left side. Turn right and thrust away to dodge.",
      "hyperspace":
        "Fatal emergency when collision is unavoidable. Hyperspace escape jump." } } } }

->  { "answers": { "action": { "choice": "turn_left_and_thrust",
                               "probabilities": { ... }, "confidence": 0.97 } } }
